title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten documented study settings in and around Alden Library, spanning quiet reading, collaborative work, reservable rooms, and technology-enabled spaces.

cards.title: Alden Library First Floor
cards.subtitle: Quiet and silent study spaces, Alden Library
cards.notes: Set up among the international collections and microforms when you want a quieter reading session; use the floor map to locate group rooms 108–112.
cards.short_summary: A collection-side floor with both quiet and silent study options.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries says Alden’s first floor offers quiet and silent study spaces and lists Group Study Rooms 108–112.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | University Libraries | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Check current library hours before visiting; late-night access is limited to current faculty, staff, and students with valid Ohio University ID.

cards.title: Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Alden Library
cards.notes: Choose this active, technology-rich setting for computer-based work or a group session; the second-floor map identifies several nearby group study rooms.
cards.short_summary: A technology-rich second-floor environment for individual or group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries describes the second-floor Learning Commons as an active, technology-rich study environment with several group study rooms.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | University Libraries | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Check current library hours before visiting; late-night access is limited to current faculty, staff, and students with valid Ohio University ID.

cards.title: Hushpods
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Alden Library
cards.notes: Use the sound-dampening pods for a contained work session, then keep printers, scanners, charging, and the service desk within the same floor.
cards.short_summary: Sound-dampening pods inside Alden’s second-floor study environment.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries lists Hushpods, identified as sound-dampening study pods, on Alden Library’s second floor.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | University Libraries | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Check current library hours before visiting; late-night access is limited to current faculty, staff, and students with valid Ohio University ID.

cards.title: CoLab
cards.subtitle: Third floor, Alden Library
cards.notes: Bring a project that benefits from making or collaboration: this alternative work space includes a makerspace, 3D-printing lab, and reservable conference/study rooms.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor alternative work space with making tools and reservable rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University identifies CoLab as an alternative study and working space on Alden’s third floor with a makerspace, 3D-printing lab, and reservable rooms.
cards.access_notes: CoLab posts its own operating hours and follows Alden Library hours and closures; check the current schedule before going.

cards.title: Alden Library Third Floor
cards.subtitle: Quiet and group study settings, Alden Library
cards.notes: Pick this floor when your work may shift between solo focus and group discussion; its map also identifies computers, scanners, and instructional labs.
cards.short_summary: A flexible floor combining quiet work, group work, computers, and study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries says Alden’s third floor mixes quiet and group study environments, group study rooms, instructional labs, and computers.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | University Libraries | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Check current library hours before visiting; late-night access is limited to current faculty, staff, and students with valid Ohio University ID.

cards.title: Class of 1951 Lounge
cards.subtitle: Fourth floor, Alden Library
cards.notes: Use the lounge as an open study option when it is not hosting a library or campus event; confirm the day’s room schedule if you need a dependable seat.
cards.short_summary: A fourth-floor lounge that can also host library and campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries lists the Class of 1951 Lounge on Alden’s fourth floor and notes that library and campus events are often held there.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | University Libraries | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Event use may affect availability; check current library hours and the room schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Very Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: Fourth floor, Alden Library
cards.notes: Head here for low-distraction individual work, with the fourth-floor help desk, lockers, printers, and Group Study Room 401B also on the floor.
cards.short_summary: A designated very-quiet fourth-floor setting with nearby study support services.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries lists a Very Quiet Study Area, Group Study Room 401B, lockers, printers, and a help desk on Alden’s fourth floor.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | University Libraries | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Check current library hours before visiting; late-night access is limited to current faculty, staff, and students with valid Ohio University ID.

cards.title: Alden Library Fifth Floor
cards.subtitle: Quiet study near archives and maps
cards.notes: Settle in on this quiet floor when you want to work near Government Documents, Maps, the archives, or the Ryan Room; keep your voice low.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study floor alongside government documents, maps, and archives.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries identifies Alden’s fifth floor as a quiet study space and lists Government Documents and Maps, the archives, and the Ryan Room.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | University Libraries | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Check current library hours before visiting; late-night access is limited to current faculty, staff, and students with valid Ohio University ID.

cards.title: Alden Library Sixth Floor
cards.subtitle: Book stacks and campus overlook
cards.notes: Use a spot among the A–LT stacks for quiet work with a campus view; plan research pulls around the call-number ranges housed on this floor.
cards.short_summary: A quiet sixth-floor stacks setting with a campus view.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries calls Alden’s sixth floor a popular place for quiet study that overlooks campus and says it holds call numbers A–LT.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | University Libraries | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Check current library hours before visiting; late-night access is limited to current faculty, staff, and students with valid Ohio University ID.

cards.title: Alden Library Seventh Floor
cards.subtitle: Top-floor quiet study, Alden Library
cards.notes: Take a table on the top floor for a quiet study session with campus views, and use the nearby P–ZA stacks or Children’s Collection for research breaks.
cards.short_summary: A quiet top-floor setting with campus views and book stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries describes Alden’s top floor as a popular place for quiet study with views overlooking campus and lists call numbers P–ZA.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | University Libraries | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Check current library hours before visiting; late-night access is limited to current faculty, staff, and students with valid Ohio University ID.
